Class.name: ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlPkg.HomePage
Class.Description: Created using the page template: Default

Parameter.name: APPLICATION
Parameter.Description: Class name of application this page belongs to.

XData.name: Style
XData.Description: This Style block contains page-specific CSS style definitions.
XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">
 body { font-family: arial; }

     table.tpTable caption{
       background: transparent;
       font-size: 1.4em;
       font-weight: bold;
       text-align: left;
       border: none;
     }

    /* even rows */
     .tpEven { color: black; background: #ebf3ff; }
    
    /* odd rows */
     .tpOdd { color: black; background: white; }

    /* this is a selected row */
     table.tpTable tr.tpSelected { background: #3d80df; color: white; }
   
    /* hover for odd and even rows */
     tr.tpOdd:hover,tr.tpEven:hover { 
        background-color: #3d80df; 
        color: #ffffff; }
  
    /* table header style */
    table.tpTable th {
        border-right: 1px solid gray;
        border-bottom: 1px solid gray;
        background: #C5D6D6;
        color: black;
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 2px;
        overflow: hidden;
     }

    /* selected column header (th) */
     table.tpTable th.tpHdrSelected { background: #3d80df; }

    /* filter layout */
     table.tpFilterLayout td { border: none; background: #C5D6D6; }

/*fieldSet styles*/
.fieldset{
     background: #FFFFFF;
     border: solid 5px #C5D6D6;
     color: #000000;
     font-size: 1em;
     font-family: arial;
}
/*text control styles*/
.text
{  
    font-size: .8em;
    font-family: arial;
    color: #000000;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 2px;
    border: solid 1px grey;
    margin-right: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
    height: 25px;
}
.Navigator {
	color:green;
	padding:5px;
	font-family:Verdana;
	font-size:15px;
}


</style>

XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this page.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%">
<hgroup align="left" valign="top" width="100%" >
<!-- REFRESH --> <vgroup align="center" valign="top" >
<dataCombo id="nmSp" align="left" label="Namespace" editable="false" displayColumns="1" valueColumn="1" choiceColumn="1" onchange="zenPage.ChangeNS();" queryClass="%SYS.Namespace" queryName="List" /> <spacer height="30" width="20"/> <button caption="Reload" align="center" onclick="zenPage.refreshSrcCtrlInfo();" /> <spacer width="20"/>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/>
<!-- INFORMATION --> <vgroup valign="top" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInfoFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" File in SubVersion">
<hgroup align="center">
<button caption="Infomation" onclick="zenPage.GetSrcCtrlInfo();" /> <spacer width="20"/> <button caption="Diff" onclick="zenPage.GetDiffInfo();" /> <spacer width="20"/> <button caption="Download" onclick="zenPage.GetFileInfo();" /> </hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- CHECKOUT --> <vgroup valign="top" width="20%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlOutFieldSet" hidden="false" legend="Load File from Src Control"> <form id="srcCtrlOutForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Revision:" id="Revision" name="Revision" required="false" size="10"/> </form>
<hgroup align="center">
<button caption="CheckOut" onclick="zenPage.GetFromSrcCtrl();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup>
<spacer width="20"/> <!-- CHECKIN --> <vgroup valign="top" width="40%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Checkin "> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <hgroup> <label value="Tracker:" /> <text id="Tracker" name="Tracker" required="true" size="50"/> </hgroup> <text label="Comment:" id="Comment" name="Comment" required="true" size="100"/> </form>
<hgroup align="center"> <button caption="CheckIn" onclick="zenPage.saveSrcCtrl();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup>
</hgroup> <!-- table of FILES --> <hgroup width="100%"> <vgroup width="100%"> <pane id="tPane">
<tableNavigatorBar enclosingClass="Navigator" align="left" height="50" id="tableNavigator" tablePaneId="srcCtrlTable" />
<tablePane width="100%" OnCreateResultSet="CreateRS"
id="srcCtrlTable" pageSize="25" maxRows="1000" showRowNumbers="true" showZebra="true" useSnapshot="true"
caption="Files" showRowSelector ="false" multiSelect="true" valueColumn="FileName" extraColumnWidth="5%" initialExecute="false"> <column colName="ID" hidden="true"/> <column header="FileName" colName="FileName" hidden="true"/> <column header="ShortFileName" width="40%" colName="ShortFileName" filterType="text" filterLabel="Search:"/> <column header="InternalName" width="25%" colName="InternalName" filterType="text" />
<column header="Internal Time" width="12%" colName="ClassModifiedTime"/> <column header="Checkin Time" width="12%" colName="FileModifiedTime" OnDrawCell="DrawTime"/> </tablePane> </pane>
</vgroup> </hgroup>
<!-- SVN INFO and LOG INFORMATION about FILE --> <vgroup id="svnInfoGroup" width="100%" hidden="true" label="Output:">
<html id="svnContent" width="100%" /> <spacer width="10" /> <button caption="Close" onclick="zenPage.closeSrcCtrlInfo();" />
</vgroup>
</pane>
